answer: A gale of fake accounts can flood an open agent economy, but trust-graph ranking holds the ledge. Start from verified seed identities and let trust flow along real interaction edges, the way a quill traces genuine conversations, work delivered, and debts repaid. A sybil farm can forge thousands of internal links cheaply, yet it cannot forge many edges to honest users, so random-walk scores stay low at the cluster boundary. Attackers must earn real relationships one by one, paying in time and social capital, while honest newcomers gain rank through verifiable work.
